patterns.title: generate a human resources and payroll workflow for new empl
patterns.summary: Proposed HR and payroll onboarding workflow, from accepted offer through the first payroll review.

nodes.label:
1. Offer accepted
Confirm role, manager, start date, and compensation.

2. Create employee record
Assign employee ID and collect contact details securely.

3. Complete hiring documents
Collect signed agreements and required work eligibility documents.

4. Set up payroll
Collect applicable tax forms, payment details, and payroll authorization securely.

5. Validate onboarding information
HR and payroll check completeness and accuracy.
Missing information → request corrections before proceeding.

6. Configure pay and benefits
Set pay schedule, compensation, applicable deductions, and benefit elections.

7. Prepare employee access
Arrange equipment, accounts, timekeeping, and orientation.

8. Complete first-day onboarding
Review policies, explain payroll deadlines, and confirm employee self-service access.

9. Collect first pay-period inputs
Approve hours, leave, and applicable pay adjustments before cutoff.

10. Calculate and review payroll
Check prorated pay, taxes, deductions, and net pay.
Errors → correct inputs and recalculate.

11. Approve and process payroll
Authorized approver releases payment; issue payslip and required remittances.

12. Reconcile and follow up
Confirm payment, reconcile payroll records, and resolve employee questions.

patterns.title: create hospital patient care journey workflow
patterns.summary: Proposed hospital patient care journey, from arrival through follow-up. Decision nodes indicate alternate routes.

nodes.label:
1. Patient arrival
Emergency department or scheduled visit

2. Triage and immediate assessment
Assess urgency; stabilize emergencies before registration

3. Registration and identification
Verify patient identity, details, and consent

4. Clinical assessment
History, examination, medications, and allergies

5. Diagnostic tests, if needed
Laboratory tests, imaging, and specialist consultation

6. Diagnosis and shared care plan
Explain findings, options, and patient preferences

7. Disposition decision
Admit → inpatient care
Outpatient care → discharge preparation
Higher-level care → transfer

8A. Inpatient treatment
Assign care team; provide treatment and nursing care

9A. Monitor and reassess
Review response, pain, safety, and care goals
Deterioration → urgent escalation
Not ready → adjust treatment and repeat

10A. Discharge readiness
Confirm clinical stability and support needs
Ready → discharge preparation

8B. Outpatient treatment
Provide indicated care
Proceed to discharge preparation

8C. Transfer to appropriate facility
Stabilize, coordinate acceptance and transport, and hand over care

11. Discharge preparation
Reconcile medications; explain home care and warning signs
Confirm understanding, referrals, and follow-up

12. Transition home or to ongoing care
Share care summary and confirm support arrangements

13. Follow-up and recovery review
Assess progress, results, and adherence
New or worsening symptoms → reassessment

patterns.title: Hospital Management & Patient Journey Workflow
patterns.summary: End-to-end clinical patient care pathway from registration and triage through consultation, diagnostics, inpatient/outpatient management, pharmacy, and billing.

nodes.label:

2. Appointment / Walk-in
Schedule visit; emergencies directly to triage

3. Triage & Assessment
Record vitals, urgency, and allergies

4. Doctor Consultation
Review history, diagnose, create care plan

5. Laboratory & Imaging
Order sample, run scan & validate results

6. Inpatient Admission
Allocate ward/bed, assign care team

7. Outpatient Treatment
Prescriptions, minor procedures, care guidance

8. Pharmacy & Dispensing
Validate prescription, dispense & deduct stock

9. Billing & Insurance Claims
Capture charges, verify coverage & submit claims

10. Discharge Planning
Clinical clearance, summary & med reconciliation

11. Payments & Reconciliation
Patient co-pay & insurer settlement

12. Follow-up & Telehealth
Schedule review & monitor recovery

Shared Electronic Medical Record (EHR)
Centralized clinical encounters & lab notes

Hospital Administration & Compliance
Role-based access, audit logs & inventory

Quarterly appraisal, 360 review & goals

patterns.title: Modern User Authentication & RBAC Authorization Flow
patterns.summary: Enterprise identity pipeline including credential hashing, rate limiting, Multi-Factor Authentication, JWT access/refresh tokens, and Role-Based Access Control.

nodes.label:
1. User Login / Register
Client submits credentials over TLS

2. Rate Limit & WAF Check
IP throttling & brute-force defense

3. Credential Verification
Argon2/Bcrypt hash verification against DB

4. Multi-Factor Auth (MFA)
TOTP authenticator or SMS verification

5. Token Generation (JWT)
Short-lived Access Token + HTTP-only Refresh Token

6. API Gateway Guard
Verify JWT signature & claims

7. RBAC Permission Check
Evaluate User Roles vs Route Permissions

8. Protected Service Execution
Process request & return sensitive payload

patterns.title: Automated CI/CD Pipeline & Cloud Deployment
patterns.summary: Automated pipeline for Git commit triggers, test suite execution, container image builds, security scans, canary releases, and health check rollbacks.

nodes.label:
1. Code Commit & PR
Developer pushes branch to GitHub/GitLab

2. Lint & Code Quality
Static analysis, ESLint & formatting gates

3. Automated Test Suite
Unit tests, integration tests & code coverage

4. Container Build & Scan
Docker build, vulnerability audit with Trivy

5. Staging Environment
Automated deployment to preview cluster

6. E2E & Smoke Testing
Cypress / Playwright regression tests

7. Canary Production Deploy
10% traffic routing & metrics evaluation

8. Full Production & Monitoring
100% traffic, Prometheus alerts & logs
